name: Hannah Turner

events.title: Marriage to James Prindle
events.description: Bride written 'Anar Turner' in the Newtown church register; FamilySearch has the date as 2 Jan 1759

bioAdditions: The Newtown church register records the marriage of James Prindle and 'Anar Turner' on 22 Jan 1759 (S1, image already held under James Prindle). FamilySearch identifies her as Hannah Turner, daughter of Samuel Turner (1713-1794) and Rebeckah Cheesebrough, born at New London on 7 Sep 1738, and says she died on 19 Jul 1838 aged 99 and was buried at Stonington (S2). That identification is doubtful: the same FamilySearch family also has a sister 'Anna Turner' born in 1740, and 'Anar' is a closer spelling of Anna/Anner than of Hannah. Her attached birth records are indexed under both 'Anner Turner' and 'Hannah Turner'. The death and burial carry no source, and a widow of a Newtown man buried in Stonington at 99 needs proof. FamilySearch also gives her children born in 1754 and 1757, before the 1759 marriage, so those two (James 'Pringle' 1754-1828 and David 1757) cannot be hers unless the marriage date is wrong. The other children are Benjamin (1764), Samuel (c.1767, our Samuel Pringle) and Hannah (1773).
